sources.name: BCCLS libraries event calendar (LibCal)
sources.notes: Already known, listed for the recipe. The page itself renders empty to WebFetch, but the JSON feed behind it is public: /ajax/calendar/list?c=-1&date=0000-00-00&perpage=40&page=1&audience=&cats=&camps=&inc=0 returned 263 events for one day with title, start time, library and event URL. Keyword search is client-side (URL form ?t=d&q=concert&cid=-1&cal=-1&inc=0), so filter titles yourself for concert, jazz, film, author, open mic. Feed includes non-Bergen member libraries (Montclair, Secaucus, West Caldwell, Roseland); drop those. Per-library URLs exist, e.g. /calendar/hackensack.

search_recipes: Read baselocal.com/nj/bergen-county/events/ in two passes (offset 0 and 100000) and keep anything tagged music, comedy, theater, film, book or craft
thelocalmusicfinder.com/venue/<slug>-<id> for each Bergen bar; then follow each /band/ link for the act's own schedule and socials
curl 'https://bccls.libcal.com/ajax/calendar/list?c=-1&date=YYYY-MM-DD&perpage=40&page=N&audience=&cats=&camps=&inc=0' and filter titles for concert|jazz|music|film|movie|author|open mic|paint
firecrawl scrape https://barrymorefilmcenter.org/full-schedule --wait-for 3000 (Tockify widget; plain fetch returns stale data)
firecrawl search 'facebook.com/groups "Bergen County" live music bands' (surfaces public group posts with fresh gig flyers in the snippets)
site:tickettailor.com OR site:eventbrite.com "Carlstadt, NJ" OR "East Rutherford, NJ" comedy
site:songkick.com/venues Rutherford OR Teaneck OR Englewood (per-room concert lists, e.g. Black Box at Williams Center)
feverup.com/en/fort-lee-nj-us/candlelight for all Candlelight dates and prices
"<band name>" site:thelocalmusicfinder.com/band to turn a flyer name into a full gig list
gaps: Facebook and Instagram could not be read without logging in. Groups and pages listed here were confirmed by search snippets only: LIve Music Bergen County NJ, North Jersey LIVE MUSIC, New Jersey Cover Bands, New Jersey Comedy Open Mics, The Heart of Bergen County, ArtsBergen Creates + Connects, Glen Rock Inn, Gold Dust Dreams, FB & Son's, Lou's Tavern.

Venues that BaseLocal surfaced via Facebook Events but whose own calendars I could not locate or load: Untamed Arts (Hackensack craft workshops, several a week), 82 Oak Bar & Bistro (Garfield), Rare Bird / Ramsey Golf & Country Club, Lenora's Bar (Hackensack), Hansil's (Oakland), Forte Piano (Paramus recitals), Center for Modern Dance Education (Hackensack; site failed TLS), Temple Israel (Ridgewood), Our Lady of Mount Carmel (Ridgewood), Helen Farabee Center (Carlstadt Mixed Chorus), The Treasury at Felina (Ridgewood).
Elks, VFW and American Legion halls: only one public dance found (Paramus Elks, Nov 29, via a musician's gig list). No lodge calendar or page located.

Bookstores: Bookends in Ridgewood (site failed certificate check) and Barnes & Noble Paramus (store page would not render) could not be read. Books & Greetings' calendar loaded but was empty for November.
High school theater: no page lists fall plays with public tickets; only an annual spring-musical roundup (blocked) turned up. Schools would need to be checked one by one.

Dead or stale: Hurdy Gurdy Folk Music Club (board voted to stop producing concerts), Unitarian Society of Ridgewood Society Cafe page (404), Belskie Museum site (2022 copyright, no schedule), Hiram Blauvelt Art Museum (temporarily closed, reopening date unclear), Gallery Bergen (latest listing April 2026), Art Center of Northern NJ events folder (empty), Mudspinners events (2024), Skyline Theatre Company (now performing in Bloomfield, Essex County).

No usable county filter on JerseyArts (zip sort did not work), NJ Jazz Society (lists only its own events, none in Bergen), Bandsintown/Songkick city pages (dominated by New York City), Eventbrite location searches (the bergen-county slug returns statewide results).
Jazz rooms beyond Brvsh Cul7ur3 and Rustica: search snippets mention Colombia Kaliente in Englewood (Fri/Sat jazz) and Tavlin in Tenafly (Saturday Bnai Jazz); neither was verified.

Websites with no dated listings when fetched: Ridgewood Orpheus Club (flyer image only), Green Point (River Vale), Gerry's Place (Norwood), Biagio's (Paramus), Color Me Mine Ridgewood, Sunshine Pottery (Englewood), Clay Ground (Teaneck), Yellow Door Art Studio and The Crafty Kit (Westwood; dates shown without a year).
Could not reach: Ridgewood Gilbert & Sullivan Opera Company, Ridgewood Concert Band, Grant Street Cafe (Dumont), Garage Theatre Group, Dakota Leigh's own site (all connection or certificate errors).
